tokenize_text_with_regexp: create a RegexpTokenizer and call tokenize on a string to get PTB-style tokens
tokenize_with_quote_normalization: create a RegexpTokenizer with substitutions enabled to normalize unicode quotes to ASCII equivalents
tokenize_without_substitutions: create a RegexpTokenizer with substitutions disabled to preserve original quote and dash characters
extract_token_spans: tokenize text with RegexpTokenizer and use offsets to get character-level spans for each token
untokenize_tokens: tokenize text with RegexpTokenizer then call untokenize to reconstruct the original text with whitespace
